name: Pullman Kuala Lumpur City Centre Hotel & Residences
short_description: A 450-room hotel plus 157 residences on Jalan Conlay opposite Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, with a 29th-floor executive lounge and four restaurants.
ai_summary: Pullman Kuala Lumpur City Centre Hotel & Residences sits on Jalan Conlay directly opposite Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, with Suria KLCC and the Petronas Twin Towers also within easy reach. The property combines 450 contemporary hotel rooms and suites with 157 separately configured residences, four restaurants, and an executive lounge on the 29th floor that guests single out for its hot appetizers during happy hour. Reviewers consistently praise the central, walkable location and spacious rooms, particularly the two-bathroom suites on higher floors, while a subset of reviews note outdated decor in places and occasional lapses in cleanliness or furniture upkeep.

faqs.question: Is Pullman Kuala Lumpur City Centre close to Pavilion Mall?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits directly opposite Pavilion Kuala Lumpur on Jalan Conlay, with Suria KLCC and the Petronas Twin Towers also within easy walking or short-drive distance.

faqs.question: Does Pullman Kuala Lumpur City Centre have residences?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside 450 hotel rooms and suites, the property includes 157 separately configured residences, giving longer-stay guests apartment-style options within the same building.
